<title level="1" right="Creature Family">[Dragon, Omen](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=403)</title>

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 123

Fate is a fickle matter on Golarion. Even with prophecy broken on the world, there are ways to look to the immediate future or acquire a vague sense of long-term events. Omen dragons are bound to see the future—nebulous though it might be—at all times. Visions of the future hound them like a quiet song that never stops playing in their minds. While an omen dragon can focus on or ignore the music of fate at any time, the song plays all the same. At a glance, omen dragons resemble other occult dragons in appearance, save for the mirror-like interior membrane of their wings. An omen dragon's wings offer glimpses into the future. These glimpses are cloudy and vague, but generally correct, if only technically. Omen dragons have a natural compulsion to share the futures they see. These dragons have no compunctions about what the visions show and share their knowledge equally with innocent villagers as they do with wicked tyrants.

<title level="2">Members</title>
[Adult Omen Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2954) (Creature 11), [Ancient Omen Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2955) (Creature 16), [Young Omen Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2953) (Creature 7)

<aside>
<title level="2" noclass="true" icon="/images/Icons/Sidebar_4_RelatedCreatures.png">Gurvallinn</title>

The omen dragon Gurvallinn has become a common sight in the Eye of Dread region of Avistan. The reemergence of the lich Tar-Baphon brought about many dangers for the region. Gurvallinn, beset by countless portents, travels between the nations of the region to share his visions with locals, though many of these warnings are vague, making acting on the information difficult.
</aside>

<aside>
<title level="2" noclass="true" icon="/images/Icons/Sidebar_3_Locations.png">Omen Dragon Lairs</title>

Omen dragons maintain multiple lairs, as if different futures require a distinct lair. Each lair has a smaller hoard than that of a typical dragon, but these hoards seem to be more impactful. In addition to riches, an omen dragon hoards items of significance. These could be fabled weapons, cures for a plague yet to happen, or other items that the dragon has seen in a vision and recognizes as important. Many desperate travelers make the journey to these lairs in hopes of finding the miraculous item that will solve their problems. Omen dragons are open to sharing these items, but if the dragon is unsure of the item's purpose, the visitor needs to assure the dragon of the item's fate and not some unforeseen future possibility.
</aside>

<aside>
<title level="2" noclass="true" icon="">Omen Dragon Spellcasters</title>

Omen dragon spellcasters tend to cast the following spells. 

### Young Omen Dragon
 **Occult Prepared Spells** DC 25, attack +17; **3rd** [_dream message_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1503), [_hypercognition_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1563); **2nd** [_clear mind_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1469), [_status_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1690), [_stupefy_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1691); **1st** [_command_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1470), [_fear_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1524), [_protection_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1641); **Cantrips (3rd)** [_daze_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1482), [_detect magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1485), [_know the way_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1582), [_message_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1598), [_read aura_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1646) 

### Adult Omen Dragon
 **Occult Prepared Spells** DC 30, attack +22; As young omen dragon, plus **5th** [_locate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1588), [_wave of despair_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1757); **4th** [_clairvoyance_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1466), [_confusion_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1471), [_read omens_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1647); **3rd** _locate_; **Cantrips (5th)** _daze_, _detect magic_, _know the way_, _message_, _read aura_ 

### Ancient Omen Dragon
 **Occult Prepared Spells** DC 39, attack +31; As adult omen dragon, plus **7th** [_never mind_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1614), [_visions of danger_](/Spells.aspx?ID=358), [_warp mind_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1754); **6th** [_repulsion_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1650), [_scrying_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1662), [_truesight_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1727); **5th** [_sending_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1665); **Cantrips (7th)** _daze_, _detect magic_, _know the way_, _message_, _read aura_
</aside>

<title level="2" right="Creature Family Group">Dragon</title>

**Related Families**
[Dragon, Adamantine](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=396), [Dragon, Conspirator](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=397), [Dragon, Diabolic](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=398), [Dragon, Empyreal](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=399), [Dragon, Fortune](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=400), [Dragon, Horned](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=401), [Dragon, Mirage](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=402)
